levels.needs_practice: Recipient would have to guess who, what or when
levels.foundation: Main request is clear, one detail missing (often time or owner)
levels.proficient: Recipient can act at once: what, who, by when, and why

levels.needs_practice: Same message whoever reads it, or too long or thin
levels.foundation: Some adaptation, such as shorter for the boss
levels.proficient: Content, length and register clearly suit this reader

levels.needs_practice: Dismissive, blaming, mocking, hostile, or ignores upset customer
levels.foundation: Courteous and neutral, little acknowledgement or direction
levels.proficient: Acknowledges feelings, owns mistakes, firm on facts

levels.needs_practice: Assumes facts, asks nothing when information is missing
levels.foundation: Asks at least one relevant question or confirms a fact
levels.proficient: Asks targeted questions that change the plan and checks understanding

levels.needs_practice: No named owners or no deadlines
levels.foundation: Owners named for most tasks, deadlines partly
levels.proficient: Every task has owner and deadline fitting budget/time limit

levels.needs_practice: No decision, or a decision with no reason
levels.proficient: Decision weighs a trade-off and says why

levels.needs_practice: Ignores or dismisses a struggling teammate
levels.proficient: Acknowledges, changes plan concretely, plans check-in
Names own decision, what went wrong, specific change for next time

levels.needs_practice: Restates symptoms or jumps to a solution
levels.foundation: States a problem, partly tied to what was learned
levels.proficient: Frames specific problem for specific person, grounded in evidence
Two+ clearly different options, with choice and reason
Uses several facts and respects stated constraints
Changes idea in response to feedback and states learning
Figures and their implication both correct

levels.needs_practice: Pays or discounts without looking at cash
levels.foundation: Weighs cash or customer, not both
levels.proficient: Weighs both, with numbers, and proposes a path
